rules: The control-state branch is durable coordination state, not product source authority.
Every state transition starts from the exact remote state-branch head observed immediately before the transition.
A state transition is committed once and pushed fast-forward-only. Non-fast-forward rejection is a lost compare-and-set and requires reread/reconciliation, never force.
repository_writer_epoch strictly increases when a new canonical writer lease is granted.
owner_claim_epochs[owner_lane] strictly increases whenever a new mutation-capable owner-lane claim is granted after release or expiry.
At most one unexpired mutation-capable owner claim may exist for an owner_lane; foreground chat, Second Shift, and system automation are mutually exclusive claim modes.
A previously issued repository-writer or owner-claim epoch never becomes valid again after a higher epoch exists.
Terminal event_id values are append-only and deduplicated globally.
operation_id and idempotency_key obey GITHUB-OPERATION-LEDGER-SCHEMA-001 semantic identity law.
State reconstruction must be possible from the latest state record plus append-only operation/event records.
Actions cache, runner workspace, chat memory and workflow run state are not durable coordination authority.
